metadata.title: Vintage Map and Studio Microphone Album Art

retrievalProfile.description: A vintage-inspired layout featuring a detailed condenser microphone overlaid on an aged parchment map with bold, 1970s-style script lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, sepia-toned composition where a realistic studio microphone stands on the right, partially overlapping a large, stylized script logo centered on an aged, textured map background.
coreVisualRelationships: Microphone overlaps the script logo on the right side
Large logo dominates the central and left-middle ground
Textured map serves as the foundational background layer
Secondary script text sits horizontally in the lower third
coreInvariants: Warm sepia and ochre color palette
High-contrast white lettering with dark outlines
Realistic metallic rendering of the microphone

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large script logo centered; condenser microphone scaled to full height on the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white-filled script logo in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large central logo, moves right to the microphone detail, then down to the secondary subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The map background provides 'active' negative space with its lines and geographic names.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, warm tones with high-value white highlights in the typography.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and metallic grays

letterConstructionRules: Thick, fluid strokes with heavy bottom-weighting
Large, looping swashes on initial and terminal characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital features an enclosed loop that cradles subsequent letters
Terminal letters extend into long, horizontal underlines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, 70s-style display script paired with a lighter, more traditional formal cursive.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows for legibility against busy backgrounds

preserve: The looping swash of the first letter

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, rounded 70s script aesthetic
Good match for the secondary formal cursive subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution image of an aged, sepia-toned parchment map of the Southern United States. On the right side, place a realistic silver condenser microphone in a shock mount, angled slightly. The lighting should be warm and directional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, custom script logo in the center using a bold 70s-style font with a white fill and dark brown double-outline. Below it, add a subtitle in a smaller, elegant white cursive script with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the microphone on the right side?
Does the map have a visible parchment texture?
Is the main logo white with a dark outline?
Are the colors restricted to a warm sepia palette?

mustRedesign: Specific city names on the map
Exact brand logos on the microphone

mustAchieve: Clean, legible script despite the busy background
Realistic metallic sheen on the microphone

postGenerationChecks: Check for double-outline on the main text
Ensure the microphone doesn't obscure the legibility of the main word
Verify the map looks like physical paper, not a digital filter
Confirm the subtitle is centered horizontally
recipe.reuseFormula: Aged Map Background + Studio Microphone (Right) + Heavy 70s Script (Center) + Cursive Subtitle (Bottom) = Retro Americana Music Aesthetic
